versions.changelog:
Social Media Kit initial release.

- Generate a full week (or custom duration) of platform-optimized posts from a single topic or brand.
- Outputs include structured JSON for schedulers, a printable HTML content calendar, and platform tailoring for Twitter, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
- Includes hashtag suggestions, posting time recommendations, and automatic content mix (educational, promotional, engaging).
- Comprehensive CLI for content generation, calendar creation, and auto-detecting topics from text.
- Features documentation of platform best practices and content strategy references.
